frontend and platform engineering teams here is the comprehensive rollout plan for our monorepo migration to pnpm workspaces and turborepo. first check pnpm dash workspace dot yaml in the repository root to verify that packages wildcard includes packages slash asterisk apps slash asterisk and tools slash asterisk. inspect root package dot json to confirm that package manager field is pinned to pnpm at nine point one point zero. in packages slash ui slash src slash index dot tsx verify that all shared react components export typed properties with named exports rather than default exports. in apps slash web slash next dot config dot js confirm that transpile packages array contains at enterprise slash ui and at enterprise slash utils. the build orchestration in turbo dot json must configure build task with depends on caret build and outputs dist slash asterisk and dot next slash asterisk. developers must execute local builds using pnpm exec turbo run build dash dash filter equal sign web point ellipsis to build the web application and all upstream dependencies. under no circumstances should any developer commit package dash lock dot json or yarn dot lock to the git repository as pnpm dash lock dot yaml is the sole authoritative lockfile. the ci pipeline in dot github slash workflows slash ci dot yaml must run pnpm install dash dash frozen dash lockfile with cache enabled for pnpm store. in packages slash api client slash src slash client dot ts verify that axios instance configures timeout of fifteen seconds and retries failed get requests up to three times with exponential backoff. furthermore the core library in packages slash core slash src slash types dot ts must declare strict typescript compiler options with dash dash strict null checks and dash dash no implicit any enabled. the release coordinator confirmed that semantic release workflows will automatically publish packages to our private npm registry when pull requests merge into main. developers working on docker images must inspect dockerfile dot web to verify that pnpm fetch dash dash prod pre-downloads production dependencies before the multi-stage build. the site reliability team requires that bundle size analyzer thresholds in apps slash web fail pull requests if initial javascript bundle exceeds two hundred fifty kilobytes. in addition inspect eslint dot config dot js to verify that eslint rules enforce import order boundaries prohibiting circular dependencies between workspace packages. the mobile team in apps slash mobile confirm that react native metro bundler configures watch folders to resolve workspace symlinks cleanly. testing infrastructure in vitest dot workspace dot ts must execute unit test suites across all packages in parallel using dash dash max workers four. security operations confirmed that pnpm audit dash dash audit dash level high must run on every pull request to block known critical vulnerabilities. all developers should execute pnpm store prune weekly to clear orphaned package tarballs from local storage drives. the documentation website in apps slash docs must compile with docusaurus three using pnpm dash dash filter docs build to verify zero broken markdown links. ensure that git hooks managed by husky in dot husky slash pre dash commit run lint-staged on staged files before allowing commits. in dot github slash codeowners verify that core platform team is assigned as required code reviewers for pnpm dash workspace dot yaml and turbo dot json. the engineering productivity lead confirmed that cold cache ci build times must remain under four minutes and warm cache builds under ninety seconds. inspect scripts slash migrate slash cleanup dot sh to verify that legacy node modules and dot cache directories are purged before executing the initial pnpm install. furthermore developer documentation in docs slash guides slash monorepo dot md must be updated with onboarding instructions and common troubleshooting steps for workspace linking. all developers must install pnpm globally using corepack enable pnpm prior to monday morning's sprint kickoff. furthermore in package dot json add engines field requiring node greater than or equal to eighteen point zero point zero and pnpm greater than or equal to nine point zero point zero. the release engineering team requires that git tag formats use package name at version syntax for multi-package releases. in dot npmrc configure shamefully hoist to false to guarantee strict dependency isolation across workspace packages. also configure auto install peers to true in dot npmrc to avoid manual peer dependency resolutions in component packages. the frontend developer lead confirmed that bundle size limits must be configured for all production packages in packages slash ui. all developers must run pnpm dedupe weekly to eliminate duplicate transitive dependencies across workspaces. in apps slash docs slash docusaurus dot config dot js configure route base url to forward slash and enable offline search plugins. the security team requires that dependency vulnerabilities be scanned in pull requests using snyk test in addition to pnpm audit. finally verify that the monorepo root gitignore ignores all dot turbo and dot pnpm store directories before committing changes. finally schedule a live hands-on workshop for friday afternoon at three pm to walk the entire engineering organization through workspace commands and debugging techniques.
